topics.label: Lecture Introduction and Hallmarks of Cancer Overview
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer introduces the lecture scope, learning outcomes, and the conceptual framework of cancer hallmarks.

topics.label: Autonomous Growth Signaling and Proliferation Pathways
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how oncogenic mutations within cell surface receptors and intracellular signaling cascades drive uncontrolled cell proliferation and survival.

topics.label: Differentiation Block in Cancer Development
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how impaired terminal differentiation halts maturation and perpetuates proliferative states across hematological and epithelial cancers.

topics.label: Evasion of Apoptotic Cell Death
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic describes the molecular mechanisms by which cancer cells disrupt pro- and anti-apoptotic signaling balances to resist programmed cell death.

topics.label: Replicative Immortality and Senescence Regulation
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how cancer cells overcome telomere-induced proliferative limits and bypass normal senescence checkpoints to achieve indefinite replication.

topics.label: Cancer Metabolism and Metabolic Reprogramming
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics introduce complex cancer hallmarks and explore the rewiring of metabolic pathways toward aerobic glycolysis and epigenetic modification.

topics.label: Tumor Angiogenesis
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics address the physiological requirement, progression timeline, and regulatory balance of new blood vessel recruitment in tumors.

topics.label: Mechanisms and Dynamics of Tumor Metastasis
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic outlines the biological stages, dissemination routes, diagnostic tracking methods, and genetic factors involved in metastatic cancer spread.

topics.label: Conclusion and Final Summary
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer provides concluding thoughts on hallmark integration and finishes the lecture.
